name: Arcana Domain

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: A cleric who studies and reshapes arcane magic. Some features are reference-only; see each feature’s implementation status.

feature.name: Student of Arcana
feature.summary: Choose Arcana or a Cleric starting skill; learn two Wizard cantrips as Cleric spells, replacing one when gaining a Cleric level.
feature.text: Choose Arcana or a Cleric starting skill; learn two Wizard cantrips as Cleric spells, replacing one when gaining a Cleric level.

feature.name: Modify Magic
feature.summary: When casting, spend Channel Divinity freely for one benefit: one spell target gains 2d8 + Cleric level Temporary Hit Points; or, after a visible creature succeeds on its first save against that spell, subtract 1d6 from that save.
feature.text: When casting, spend Channel Divinity freely for one benefit: one spell target gains 2d8 + Cleric level Temporary Hit Points; or, after a visible creature succeeds on its first save against that spell, subtract 1d6 from that save.

feature.name: Dispelling Recovery
feature.summary: After casting a slotted spell that heals or ends a condition on a creature, cast Dispel Magic as part of the same action, Bonus Action, or Reaction without a slot. Once per Short or Long Rest; Channel Divinity restores use without an action.
feature.text: After casting a slotted spell that heals or ends a condition on a creature, cast Dispel Magic as part of the same action, Bonus Action, or Reaction without a slot. Once per Short or Long Rest; Channel Divinity restores use without an action.

feature.name: Magical Mastery
feature.summary: Choose a Wizard spell from each level 6–9, always prepared as Cleric spells. On gaining a Cleric level, replace at most one with a Wizard spell of the same level.
feature.text: Choose a Wizard spell from each level 6–9, always prepared as Cleric spells. On gaining a Cleric level, replace at most one with a Wizard spell of the same level.
